skills.skillDescription:
[Master Level: 20]

Summons a fire spirit to split the enemy's soul from their body and siphon away their power. Targets the boss with the highest HP first when attacking multiple enemies and creates a spirit flame that burns the souls of enemies.
Enemies hit by Soul Splitter are afflicted by a debuff that drains their power, while Shade and party members who are inside the spirit flame are granted the Fire Spirit's Blessing.
The Fire Spirit's Blessing increases Final Damage when attacking an enemy afflicted with the Soul Splitter debuff. Party members who receive the blessing cannot receive it again for a set duration.
Stationary enemies cannot have their souls split, instead granting Fire Spirit's Blessing to Shade and party members within the same map. If a party member is unable to receive the blessing, they can obtain it again inside the spirit flame. Blessings granted to party members do not apply beyond the duration of the spirit flame.
Enemies affected by Soul Splitter cannot have their soul split again for 40 seconds.
skills.skillEffectDescription:
MP Cost: 100, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Damage: 720%, Number of Attacks: 10
When an attack lands, the enemy's soul is split for 30 sec, they are afflicted with a debuff, and a spirit flame is created for 10 sec at the enemy's location. The flame's duration can increase up to 100% depending on the damage dealt with Soul Splitter.
Grants the Fire Spirit's Blessing for 30 sec upon landing an attack.
Party members inside the spirit flame obtain the Fire Spirit's Blessing for 10 sec, and are unable to receive the blessing again for 110 sec.
The Fire Spirit's Blessing increases Final Damage by 20% when attacking an enemy afflicted with the Soul Splitter debuff.
EXP increases by 100% when defeating an enemy afflicted with the Soul Splitter debuff.
Cooldown: 60 sec
